steps: edit: generating opens the sheet, and its three images join the set
publish: three views tiled into one reference sheet
media: the reference sheet is what a shot can be conditioned on
regenerate: the sheet returns to edit mode with five images, not two
types: disabled is kept out of the sheet, delete is removed on publish
library: the composed sheet is the cover other projects see
ui: the sheet is edited by type, and the dropdown offers delete
ui: publishing leaves one composed reference sheet and closes the editor
